chunks: When you come to your camp at Minā, then proceed to Jamrat al-ʿAqabah, which is the furthest one, while you are in a state of taharah (ritual purity), and take out from the pebbles you have with you for the Jamarāt seven pebbles. Stand in the middle of the valley facing the qiblah, with ten or fifteen steps between you and the Jamrah, and say while facing the qiblah and the pebbles are in your left palm: “O Allah, these are my pebbles, so count them for me and raise them in my deed.”

Then take one of them and throw at the Jamrah from the side of its face, and do not throw it from above it. Say with each pebble when you throw it: “Allah is the Greatest. O Allah, drive away from me Shaytan and his troops. O Allah, make it a hajj accepted, an act accepted, an effort appreciated, and a sin forgiven. O Allah, in faith in You, in affirmation of Your Book, and upon the sunnah (prophetic tradition) of Your Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله.” Continue until you throw seven pebbles. It is permissible to say one takbir with each pebble you throw. If a pebble falls from you into the Jamrah or on your path, then take another in its place from beneath your feet, and do not take from the pebbles of the Jamarāt that have already been thrown. When you have stoned Jamrat al-ʿAqabah, everything becomes permissible for you except women and perfume.

And on the second, third, and fourth days, you stone each day with twenty-one pebbles. You stone the first Jamrah with seven pebbles and stand by it and make duʿa, and the second Jamrah with seven pebbles and stand by it and make duʿa, and the third Jamrah with seven pebbles and do not stand by it.

So when you return from stoning the Jamarāt on the Day of Sacrifice to your camp at Minā, then say: “O Allah, in You I have placed my trust, and upon You I have relied. Excellent is the Lord You are, and excellent is the Master and excellent is the Helper.”

key_terms.الطِّيبَ: perfume, which remains prohibited at that stage
key_terms.الْقِبْلَةِ: the direction faced while making the opening supplication
key_terms.تَوَكَّلْتُ: I relied upon You in trust
key_terms.جَمْرَةِ الْعَقَبَةِ: the furthest Jamrah stoned first on the Day of Sacrifice
key_terms.حَجًّا مَبْرُورًا: a hajj accepted and righteous before Allah
key_terms.حَصَى الْجِمَارِ: the pebbles used for stoning the Jamarāt
key_terms.سُنَّةِ نَبِيِّكَ: the prophetic tradition being followed in the rite

ai.seo_question: How should the Jamarāt be stoned in Minā according to this hadith, and what duʿas are recited?
ai.summary: This text sets out the rulings and supplications for returning to Minā and performing the stoning of the Jamarāt during hajj. It details the method, number of pebbles, the prescribed duʿas, and what becomes permissible after stoning Jamrat al-ʿAqabah.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
RETURNING TO MINA AND STONING THE JAMARAT
When you reach your camp in Mina, head directly to the Jamrat al-‘Aqabah (the furthest Jamrah) in a state of ritual purity (wudu). Take out seven pebbles from the stones you prepared for stoning the Jamarat.
Stand in the middle of the valley, facing the Qibla, keeping a distance of about ten to fifteen steps between yourself and the Jamrah. Hold the pebbles in your left hand and say:
"O Allah (swt), these are my pebbles, so count them for me and raise them in my record of deeds."
Then take one pebble at a time and throw it at the Jamrah from its front side, not from above it. With each pebble you throw, say:
"In the name of Allah (swt), Allah (swt) is the Greatest. O Allah (swt), make this a proof in my favor and not against me."
Continue this for all seven pebbles, ensuring each pebble lands within the designated area.
[Stoning the Jamarat]
As you approach the Jamrat al-‘Aqabah on the Day of Nahr, with your pebbles in hand, recite:
"Allah (swt) is the Greatest. O Allah (swt), drive away Satan and his forces from me. O Allah (swt), make this Hajj accepted, my actions righteous, my efforts praiseworthy, and my sins forgiven. O Allah (swt), with faith in You, affirmation of Your Book, and adherence to the Sunnah of Your Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him and his family."
Throw seven pebbles at the Jamrat al-‘Aqabah, one at a time, saying the Takbir (Allahu Akbar) with each throw. You may also recite the Takbir along with the supplication for each pebble. Ensure each pebble lands in the designated area. If a pebble falls elsewhere, pick another from the ground near you, but do not use pebbles that have already been thrown.
Once you have completed the stoning of Jamrat al-‘Aqabah, everything becomes permissible for you except for women and perfume.
On the second, third, and fourth days, throw 21 pebbles each day:
•	First Jamrah: Throw seven pebbles, then stand there and make supplications.
•	Second Jamrah: Throw seven pebbles, then stand there and make supplications.
•	Third Jamrah: Throw seven pebbles but do not make supplications after it.
After stoning on the Day of Nahr, as you return to your camp in Mina, recite:
"O Allah (swt), I place my trust in You, and upon You I rely. What an excellent Lord (azj) You are, what an excellent Master and Helper."
